he: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ ׀ הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הֹוָה מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֑יִם הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים׃
en: Halleluyah. Praise Havayah from the heavens; praise Him in the heights.
Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His hosts.

he: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ שֶׁ֣מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֑חַ הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ כׇּל־כּ֥וֹכְבֵי אֽוֹר׃
en: Praise Him, sun and moon; praise Him, all stars of light.

he: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ שְׁמֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝הַמַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר ׀ מֵעַ֬ל הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
en: Praise Him, heavens of the heavens, and the waters that are above the heavens.

he: יְֽ֭הַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֤י ה֖וּא צִוָּ֣ה וְנִבְרָֽאוּ׃
en: Let them praise the name of Havayah, for He commanded and they were created.

he: וַיַּעֲמִידֵ֣ם לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם חׇק־נָ֝תַ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר׃
en: And He established them for all time, forever; He set a statute and it shall not pass away.
Praise Havayah from the earth, sea-monsters and all the depths.

he: אֵ֣שׁ וּ֭בָרָד שֶׁ֣לֶג וְקִיט֑וֹר ר֥וּחַ סְ֝עָרָ֗ה עֹשָׂ֥ה דְבָרֽוֹ׃
en: Fire and hail, snow and vapor; storm-wind that carries out His word.
Mountains and all hills; fruit trees and all cedars.
Wild beasts and all cattle; creeping things and winged birds.
Kings of the earth and all nations; princes and all judges of the earth.
Young men and maidens too; old men together with youths.

he: יְהַלְל֤וּ ׀ אֶת־שֵׁ֬ם יְהֹוָ֗ה כִּֽי־נִשְׂגָּ֣ב שְׁמ֣וֹ לְבַדּ֑וֹ ה֝וֹד֗וֹ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃
en: Let them praise the name of Havayah, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above earth and heaven.

he: וַיָּ֤רֶם קֶ֨רֶן ׀ לְעַמּ֡וֹ תְּהִלָּ֤ה לְֽכׇל־חֲסִידָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֣י יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל עַ֥ם קְרֹב֗וֹ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
en: And He raised up a horn for His people — praise for all His devoted ones, for the children of Yisrael, the people close to Him. Halleluyah.
